items.signal_prefix: Business mix per the deck: 1Q26 revenue rose 137.1

set.signal: Business mix per the deck: 1Q26 revenue rose 137.1% YoY and 54.0% QoQ, split into IP business KRW 16.3bn and ASIC development KRW 28.0bn, with the remainder from mass production. FY2025 revenue KRW 121.0bn: ASIC development KRW 70.9bn, IP KRW 30.5bn and mass production KRW 19.6bn (more than 2x YoY as products whose development began in the company's early years entered full mass production from 2H25). Management commentary: the IP business is shifting to high-margin off-the-shelf and leading-edge (2/3nm) IP, with analog IP demand rising as thermal and power management gain importance in datacenter AI ASICs; the ASIC development portfolio pairs high-value 2/4nm datacenter AI ASICs with 5/8nm edge and device AI ASICs.

Consolidated revenue by product group (H1 2026 vs H1 2025): electronic materials KRW 163,525,261 thousand vs KRW 164,409,889 thousand (flat), fine chemicals (incl. hydrogen peroxide) KRW 143,513,200 thousand vs KRW 127,542,595 thousand, paper/environment KRW 63,499,451 thousand vs KRW 54,192,345 thousand, tapes (Tapex) KRW 79,327,894 thousand vs KRW 66,898,635 thousand, specialty gases (Soulmaterials) KRW 15,401,760 thousand vs KRW 9,433,648 thousand, other KRW 14,140,774 thousand. By destination: Korea KRW 305,406,649 thousand, China KRW 77,777,889 thousand, other countries KRW 96,223,801 thousand. set.signal: Capacity, utilisation and capex (DART half-year report filed 08-13-2026): H1 2026 capacity (175 operating days) - Ulsan fine chemicals 39.2 thousand tonnes; Jeonju plant 106.7 thousand tonnes (fine chemicals 38.5, paper/environment 57.7, electronic and secondary-battery materials 10.5). Production H1: Ulsan 33.0, Jeonju 82.3 thousand tonnes (electronic and battery materials 3.4). UTILISATION: fine chemicals Ulsan 84.2% and Jeonju 92.4%, paper/environment 75.1%, but electronic and secondary-battery materials only 32.7% (1,374 of 4,200 available hours); Tapex electronic-materials tape 68.5%. Capex: consolidated PP&E acquisitions KRW 41,905M in H1 (KRW 42,072M a year earlier); parent construction-in-progress rose to KRW 36,038M from KRW 12,396M; depreciation KRW 30,093,915,977 (vs KRW 25,148,866,398). The board approved a production-facility investment on 2026-02-10. Inventories KRW 142,414M (vs KRW 123,785M). After the period, on 2026-08-11 the board decided to set up a 100%-owned subsidiary in Taiwan.
